title: Vahtian: human-first, auditable research-integrity tools
description: Vahtian builds local-first, human-first research-integrity tools that assess whether a cited source supports a claim and record auditable decisions — CiteVahti, StudyVahti, MethodVahti, DictVahti, MatchVahti-Lite, ReviewVahti, ExtractVahti, GuidelineVahti, SynthVahti. It does not certify scientific truth.
